text:
mira: heads up — APAC GPU pools are failing to transition to Ready since the firewall rollout last night. nodes stuck in Provisioning, keystore decrypts timing out. seeing KMS 403s in node logs. anyone oncall?

alex: oncall here, can you paste a short log snippet? which subnet/az?

mira: ap-southeast-1a and 1b, warm-pool nodes. log: ```
2024-02-12T03:43:21Z keystore: decrypt request failed status=403 resp="AccessDenied"
2024-02-12T03:43:21Z node-manager: failed to fetch image-key: keystore decrypt error
2024-02-12T03:44:05Z node-manager: provisioning retry 3/5
```

toni: that smells like egress to keystore/KMS endpoint blocked by the new deny list. the change targeted external egress but probably included our keystore range. did the firewall PR tighten 0.0.0.0/0->443?

deepa: yup PR #4782 added stricter outbounds for worker subnets. security asked to lock down, and we moved to deny-by-default for new groups. we should be able to quick-allow the keystore CIDRs or add a VPC endpoint for KMS. thinking temporary fix = allowlist keystore proxy IPs. longer term = privatelink.

jen: tagging @security for approval on emergency allowlist. we need an explicit waiver if we open things up.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Revert PR 4782 requested by alex. Jenkins job #2912 queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: quick mitigation steps: 1) revert the PR (if safe) 2) patch security group to allow keystore IPs 3) scale down warm pool to avoid retry storms. i can revert now if mira confirms rollback safe.

mira: please revert. i can monitor nodes. rolling back now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Revert PR 4782 completed by alex. Jenkins job #2912 succeeded. :white_check_mark:

mira: after rollback, new node attempts show success: ```
2024-02-12T03:50:12Z keystore: decrypt succeeded status=200
2024-02-12T03:50:13Z node-manager: provisioning -> Ready
```

toni: great. postmortem items: - add KMS/keystore CIDRs to firewall allowlist in the policy docs - add CI test that validates keystore connectivity for rolling firewall changes - track timeline with security approval flow.

deepa: I'll draft the emergency waiver template and a short runbook for firewall rollouts that affect keystore. also proposing a nonblocking step: create VPC interface endpoint for KMS in APAC to remove internet egress dependency.

jen: assigned to security to vet the waiver and to networking for endpoint. recommend a short retro at 1pm to align.

mira: thanks all — nodes back to normal. will follow up with logs and incident blameless writeup.
